frequency_question: How often can the Federal Reserve Board complete all mandatory procedural and voting steps for a capital buffer activation within a 49-day window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal Board of Governors decisions regarding capital requirements and buffer frameworks; excludes informal speeches or committee discussions that lack binding regulatory force.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named instances representing major regulatory framework execution events by the Board.
known_gaps: Excludes emergency weekend liquidity actions which follow expedited statutory authorities not applicable to standard capital buffers.
skeleton: Regulatory policy adjustments requiring board notification, internal staff analysis periods, and formal voting calendars over designated intervals.
multiplier: 3 documented regulatory implementation cycles across comparable institutional frameworks over a 10-year period.
validity_reason: Federal Reserve administrative procedures and statutory notice requirements remain stable under current banking statutes.
